entries.test: Whether Character.ai and other AI startups raised rounds of tens of millions or more in the months after SVB's March 2023 collapse while having no revenue, per funding announcements and revenue reporting.
entries.note: Only the factual core can be checked. The 'without any consideration' motive part can't be seen in public evidence, and Character.ai launched a paid subscription around May 2023.

entries.test: Whether Character.ai and similar AI startups that raised large pre-revenue rounds in 2023 later became businesses with real, sustained revenue, per public revenue and financing reports.
entries.note: The claim is hyperbolic and its scope ('these') is loose. The parts saying they are 'not real companies' and about what VCs hope can't be tested; only the forecast that they won't become functional businesses can be graded.
